# Salesforce Unified Catalog: service process coordinator

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.
Curated by Skill Harbor — the official Salesforce entry point for the Unified Catalog service-process lifecycle: find and browse templates, deploy one, create a process from scratch, activate it through the ordered precondition chain, and file it under a catalog category. Instead of frozen API steps, it discovers the platform's own guided setup recipe live and follows it — so steps, ordering and safeguards always match what the org enforces — with per-user access self-healing and plain-language, name-only reporting. By @forcedotcom, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: official Salesforce skill — requires a licensed Salesforce org with Unified Catalog (no usable free tier); the connected org is fixed per session, it handles no credentials; out of scope are template content authoring, enabling the feature org-wide, Data Cloud data kits, CRM Analytics and App Framework catalogs. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
